How it all began

Our Love Story

Every great love story has a beginning, a middle, and the most beautiful forever waiting ahead.

2019

The First Meeting

We met at a little bookshop on a rainy afternoon in October. Kaide reached for the same novel, and Kleo's laugh changed everything. A coffee became two hours of conversation, and two hours became a lifetime.

2021

Adventures Together

From weekend hikes to spontaneous road trips, every adventure became better with the other by our side. We discovered that home isn't a place — it's a person.

2023

The Proposal

Under the stars in our favourite garden, Kaide got down on one knee. Through happy tears, Kleo said yes. A thousand times, yes.

2025

Forever Begins

Now we invite you, our most beloved people, to celebrate the beginning of our forever. Thank you for being part of our story.
